Website included hone ka matlab app included nahi hai. Give Setu mein mobile app add-on Advanced plan ke saath available hai.

Android app: **₹30,000 + 18% GST = ₹35,400 one-time**.  
iOS app: **₹30,000 + 18% GST = ₹35,400 one-time**.  
Complete Android + iOS bundle: **₹1,00,000 + 18% GST = ₹1,18,000 one-time**. Is bundle mein dono apps ko Play Store aur App Store par live karne ki listing, submission, compliance forms aur review handling bhi team manage karti hai.

Yeh separately designed native app nahi hota; aapki website ka mobile view app shell mein convert hota hai, jisme home-screen icon, push notifications aur app ke andar donations ke saath 80G receipt milti hai. Google Play account approximately ₹2,500/year aur Apple Developer account approximately ₹8,500/year alag se aapke organisation ke naam par hota hai.

Tight budget ho toh Android-only ₹35,400 se start karna practical rahega. Aapko Android-only chahiye ya dono platforms ka bundle? WhatsApp par team ko +91 92019 58271 par message karein ya /contact-us par enquiry bhejein.

q: Agar 5,000 supporters ko ek saath WhatsApp karna ho toh per message rate kya padega?
Template reject ho gaya toh reason kaun batayega aur dobara submit karne ka charge hai?
Donor ne pehle kabhi reply nahi kiya hai—usko promotional WhatsApp bhejna allowed hai kya?
Marketing email ke liye monthly limit kitni hai Starter plan mein?
Bounced emails aur invalid addresses ka bhi count marketing limit mein hota hai kya?
a:
Invalid addresses aur bounced emails ko system automatically suppress karta hai, isliye un par marketing email dobara send nahi hota aur sending reputation protect hoti hai.

Lekin bounced ya invalid records marketing quota mein count hote hain ya nahi, yeh quotation mein explicitly defined nahi hai. Har send se pehle screen exact recipient count aur remaining quota dikhati hai. Is specific billing point ke liye team se WhatsApp par **+91 92019 58271** ya contact form `/contact-us` par confirm karwa sakte hain.

q: Itne paise sirf receipts aur CRM ke liye? Iska hisaab kaise justify karun trustees ko?
a:
Agar aap **Advanced** plan dekh rahe hain, toh ₹80,000 + 18% GST = **₹94,400 saal ka** sirf receipts aur CRM ke liye nahi hai.

Trustees ko hisaab is tarah dikhaiye: ismein ₹2,50,000 value ka custom-coded website, hosting, SSL, maintenance, donation forms, payment gateway integration, 80G receipts, donor aur member portals, 10BD/10BE Compliance Centre, campaigns, cases, recurring donations, 25,000 active donors ki tracking, 15 admin seats, 25,000 marketing email recipients per month, WhatsApp rail, data import/export, training aur account manager included hain. Donations par commission **0%** hai.

Comparison bhi seedha hai: ₹1 crore annual collection par 3% platform ₹3,00,000 le sakta hai; Give Setu donation ka koi percentage nahi leta. Separate system chalane ka reference estimate ₹3,76,500 per year hai, aur custom website alag se ₹2,75,000 tak ho sakti hai.

Important clarification: active donors billing meter nahi hain. Sleeping aur imported donors unlimited free hain. Sirf monthly included quota ke baad 80G receipts metered hoti hain — Advanced mein 15,000 receipts/month ke baad ₹0.50 per receipt. WhatsApp messages alag se tabhi charge hote hain jab aap bhejte hain, ₹0.98 per message + GST on Advanced.

Agar organisation chhoti hai aur mainly website, receipts aur basic donor management chahiye, toh Growth **₹45,000 + GST = ₹53,100 per year** zyada sensible starting point ho sakta hai. Advanced tab justify hota hai jab aapko custom website, larger donor tracking, AI insights, unlimited 10BD batches, microsite, API ya mobile application ki zaroorat ho.

Trustees ko written comparison bhejne ke liye WhatsApp par +91 92019 58271 ya contact form https://govindaniit.com/contact-us use kijiye. Aapka organisation abhi Growth consider kar raha hai ya Advanced?
reasons: It says a custom website alone may cost ₹2,75,000 separately. The quotation assigns ₹2,75,000 to the combined custom-coded website, receipt engine and gateway integration; the standalone Advanced website value is ₹2,50,000.

q: Accountant ko full access aur volunteers ko limited access dena possible hai?
Implementation ke liye humein apni side se kaun-kaun si files aur details ready rakhni hongi?
Donor ने UPI से पैसा डाल दिया, पर नाम और PAN अधूरा है—ऐसे contribution को system में कैसे संभालते हो?
a:
अगर यह registered non-profit का donation है, तो Give Setu में direct UPI entry को उसी receipt engine में दर्ज किया जाता है। नाम या PAN अधूरा होने पर donation और receipt रुकते नहीं हैं; receipt उसी payment record से जारी होती है और donor को email से भेजी जा सकती है।

System PAN, phone या email से existing donor मिलाने की कोशिश करता है और uncertain match होने पर duplicate suggestion देता है। PAN missing हो तो automated WhatsApp और email sequence donor से valid PAN मांगती है; सही reply मिलने पर checksum validation के बाद PAN record में लिखा जाता है। Receipt में गलती हो तो original को silently edit नहीं किया जाता—उसे cancel करके linked corrected receipt जारी की जाती है।
